historical_record.description: A permit was sought for alterations: remove mezzanine floor; replace front with steel sash and brick work (public garage), estimated at $1,500.

Sold for $115,000, deed recorded February 25, 1970. The Redevelopment Agency's appraisers, filing it as a comparable sale, described two-story brick and cement auto repair and sales garage with a metal hipped roof on wood trusses, one gas pump; age about 90 years.
